author: Adrian Collins
description:
I love Daniel Polansky’s writing. Dark, gritty, emotive, cynical, imaginative, and darkly funny. And amongst all of his brilliant novels and novellas, the Low Town trilogy stands out as his best work (in my opinion). The Straight Razor Cure, Tomorrow, The Killing, and She Who Waits are grimdark fantasy perfection. Years ago, Polansky was quoted in multiple places […]
